speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes; have you noticed if these nodes are firm, fixed, or tender to the touch?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: That abdominal pain is concerning; is it localized to the right upper quadrant or does it radiate to your back or shoulder? Also, have you experienced any fever, itching, or changes in your stool color?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (suspected Hodgkin's or Non-Hodgkin's lymphoma with abdominal involvement).
